diff --git a/durability.go b/durability.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..de73e37d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability.go
@@ -0,0 +1,392 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"slices"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/crlib/crtime"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+)
+
+const (
+	// durabilityJobRetention is the number of most recent durability jobs whose
+	// outcome is retained for DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	durabilityJobRetention = 1024
+	// maxDurabilitySubscriptions bounds the number of outstanding
+	// DB.DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	maxDurabilitySubscriptions = 1024
+)
+
+var (
+	// ErrDurabilityJobExpired is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+	// job is older than the retention window.
+	ErrDurabilityJobExpired = errors.New("pebble: durability job expired")
+	// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+	// job ID was never issued for a sync commit.
+	ErrDurabilityJobUnknown = errors.New("pebble: unknown durability job")
+	// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions is delivered by DB.DurabilityNotify
+	// when the number of outstanding subscriptions is exceeded.
+	ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions = errors.New("pebble: too many outstanding durability subscriptions")
+)
+
+// DurabilityStats is a snapshot of the durability state of a DB.
+type DurabilityStats struct {
+	// HighestDurableSeqNum is the highest sequence number known to be durable.
+	HighestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// FirstErr is the first WAL sync or commit error observed.
+	FirstErr error
+	// PendingWaiters is the number of goroutines currently blocked in the
+	// WaitForDurability family of methods.
+	PendingWaiters int64
+	// TotalDurableCommits is the number of sync commits that became durable.
+	TotalDurableCommits uint64
+	// TotalFailedCommits is the number of sync commits that failed.
+	TotalFailedCommits uint64
+	// CumulativeSyncDuration is the total time spent in the WAL sync phase
+	// of sync commits.
+	CumulativeSyncDuration time.Duration
+	// MaxSyncDuration is the longest WAL sync phase of a sync commit.
+	MaxSyncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+// batchDurableState is per-batch state used to produce the BatchDurable
+// event. It lives in batchInternal and is cleared on Batch reset.
+type batchDurableState struct {
+	// db is set if the BatchDurable event is still owed for a batch committed
+	// via ApplyNoSyncWait; it is delivered from Batch.SyncWait.
+	db            *DB
+	correlationID uint64
+	size          int
+	applyDuration time.Duration
+	syncDuration  time.Duration
+	// syncStart is the time at which the batch was written to the WAL.
+	syncStart crtime.Mono
+}
+
+type durabilityJob struct {
+	id     JobID
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	err    error
+}
+
+type durabilitySub struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	ch     chan error
+}
+
+// durabilityTracker tracks which sequence numbers are durable and allows
+// callers to wait for durability.
+type durabilityTracker struct {
+	// metricsEnabled is set if EventListener.BatchDurable is configured.
+	metricsEnabled bool
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+	// lastJobID is the last durability job ID issued. Durability jobs use
+	// their own ID space so as not to perturb the DB's job IDs.
+	lastJobID atomic.Int64
+
+	mu struct {
+		sync.Mutex
+		highest   base.SeqNum
+		firstErr  error
+		closedErr error
+		// changed is closed and replaced whenever the state changes.
+		changed chan struct{}
+		subs    []durabilitySub
+
+		// jobs is a ring buffer of the most recent durability jobs.
+		jobs       [durabilityJobRetention]durabilityJob
+		jobsHead   int
+		jobsLen    int
+		maxEvicted JobID
+
+		totalDurable uint64
+		totalFailed  uint64
+		cumSync      time.Duration
+		maxSync      time.Duration
+
+		metricCount uint64
+		metricDur   time.Duration
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) init(metricsEnabled bool) {
+	t.metricsEnabled = metricsEnabled
+	t.mu.changed = make(chan struct{})
+}
+
+// broadcastLocked wakes all waiters and delivers results to satisfied
+// subscriptions.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) broadcastLocked() {
+	close(t.mu.changed)
+	t.mu.changed = make(chan struct{})
+	t.mu.subs = slices.DeleteFunc(t.mu.subs, func(s durabilitySub) bool {
+		if done, err := t.checkLocked(s.seqNum); done {
+			s.ch <- err
+			return true
+		}
+		return false
+	})
+}
+
+// checkLocked returns done=true if waiting for seqNum has concluded, along
+// with the result.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) checkLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) (done bool, err error) {
+	switch {
+	case seqNum <= t.mu.highest:
+		return true, nil
+	case t.mu.firstErr != nil:
+		return true, t.mu.firstErr
+	case t.mu.closedErr != nil:
+		return true, t.mu.closedErr
+	}
+	return false, nil
+}
+
+// record records the outcome of a sync commit.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) record(
+	jobID JobID, seqNum base.SeqNum, count uint32, syncDur time.Duration, err error,
+) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+
+	if t.mu.jobsLen == len(t.mu.jobs) {
+		t.mu.maxEvicted = max(t.mu.maxEvicted, t.mu.jobs[t.mu.jobsHead].id)
+		t.mu.jobsHead = (t.mu.jobsHead + 1) % len(t.mu.jobs)
+		t.mu.jobsLen--
+	}
+	t.mu.jobs[(t.mu.jobsHead+t.mu.jobsLen)%len(t.mu.jobs)] = durabilityJob{
+		id: jobID, seqNum: seqNum, err: err,
+	}
+	t.mu.jobsLen++
+
+	t.mu.cumSync += syncDur
+	t.mu.maxSync = max(t.mu.maxSync, syncDur)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.mu.totalFailed++
+		if t.mu.firstErr == nil {
+			t.mu.firstErr = err
+		}
+	} else {
+		t.mu.totalDurable++
+		if t.metricsEnabled {
+			t.mu.metricCount++
+			t.mu.metricDur += syncDur
+		}
+		// Every sequence number below the batch's last sequence number is
+		// durable as well since the WAL is written in sequence number order.
+		last := seqNum + base.SeqNum(count)
+		if last > 0 {
+			last--
+		}
+		t.mu.highest = max(t.mu.highest, last)
+	}
+	t.broadcastLocked()
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) close(err error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if t.mu.closedErr == nil {
+		t.mu.closedErr = err
+		t.broadcastLocked()
+	}
+}
+
+// wait blocks until seqNum is durable, a durability error is latched, the DB
+// is closed or ctx is done. Durability and close errors take precedence over
+// context errors.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wait(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	for {
+		if done, err := t.checkLocked(seqNum); done {
+			t.mu.Unlock()
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
+			t.mu.Unlock()
+			return err
+		}
+		ch := t.mu.changed
+		t.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		select {
+		case <-ch:
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+		}
+		t.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+		t.mu.Lock()
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) notify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	ch := make(chan error, 1)
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if done, err := t.checkLocked(seqNum); done {
+		ch <- err
+	} else if len(t.mu.subs) >= maxDurabilitySubscriptions {
+		ch <- ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions
+	} else {
+		t.mu.subs = append(t.mu.subs, durabilitySub{seqNum: seqNum, ch: ch})
+	}
+	return ch
+}
+
+// lookupJob returns the retained job with the given ID.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) lookupJob(jobID JobID) (durabilityJob, error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if jobID > 0 {
+		for i := 0; i < t.mu.jobsLen; i++ {
+			j := t.mu.jobs[(t.mu.jobsHead+i)%len(t.mu.jobs)]
+			if j.id == jobID {
+				return j, nil
+			}
+		}
+		if jobID <= t.mu.maxEvicted {
+			return durabilityJob{}, errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobExpired, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+		}
+	}
+	return durabilityJob{}, errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobUnknown, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) stats() DurabilityStats {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   t.mu.highest,
+		FirstErr:               t.mu.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         t.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    t.mu.totalDurable,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     t.mu.totalFailed,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: t.mu.cumSync,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        t.mu.maxSync,
+	}
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) metrics() (count uint64, dur time.Duration) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return t.mu.metricCount, t.mu.metricDur
+}
+
+// batchDurable records the outcome of a sync commit of b and invokes the
+// BatchDurable event listener. It must be called exactly once per sync
+// commit, after the WAL sync has completed or the commit has failed.
+func (d *DB) batchDurable(b *Batch, err error) {
+	s := &b.durable
+	s.db = nil
+	info := BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         int(d.durability.lastJobID.Add(1)),
+		SeqNum:        b.SeqNum(),
+		Err:           err,
+		ApplyDuration: s.applyDuration,
+		SyncDuration:  s.syncDuration,
+		CorrelationID: s.correlationID,
+		BatchSize:     s.size,
+		KeyCount:      b.Count(),
+	}
+	if err == nil {
+		// Durations are measured, but guard against a coarse clock reporting
+		// zero for a successful commit.
+		info.ApplyDuration = max(info.ApplyDuration, 1)
+		info.SyncDuration = max(info.SyncDuration, 1)
+	}
+	d.durability.record(JobID(info.JobID), info.SeqNum, info.KeyCount, info.SyncDuration, err)
+	d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(info)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurability blocks until the given sequence number is durable. It
+// returns an error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is closed before then. A
+// zero sequence number is always considered durable. If the WAL is disabled,
+// WaitForDurability returns nil immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityContext is like WaitForDurability but also returns if ctx
+// is done. Durability and close errors take precedence over the context
+// error.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until every sequence number in seqNums is
+// durable. It returns nil if seqNums is empty.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatchContext is like WaitForDurabilityBatch but also
+// returns if ctx is done.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	// Durability is monotonic in the sequence number, so it suffices to wait
+	// for the largest one.
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, slices.Max(seqNums))
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurability waits for the sync commit identified by the
+// BatchDurableInfo.JobID to be durable, returning the commit's error if it
+// failed. Jobs older than the retention window return an error wrapping
+// ErrDurabilityJobExpired; zero and never issued job IDs return an error
+// wrapping ErrDurabilityJobUnknown.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Background(), jobID)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurabilityContext is like WaitForJobDurability but also returns
+// if ctx is done.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	j, err := d.durability.lookupJob(JobID(jobID))
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if j.err != nil {
+		return j.err
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, j.seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurableState returns the highest durable sequence number and the first
+// WAL sync or commit error encountered, if any.
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+	return d.durability.mu.highest, d.durability.mu.firstErr
+}
+
+// DurabilityNotify returns a channel which receives exactly one value: nil
+// once seqNum is durable, or an error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is
+// closed first. The channel is buffered so the result is never dropped. If
+// too many subscriptions are outstanding, the channel immediately delivers
+// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		ch := make(chan error, 1)
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+	return d.durability.notify(seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats returns a snapshot of the DB's durability statistics.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	return d.durability.stats()
+}
diff --git a/durability_test.go b/durability_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..d4cf44d4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,226 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/vfs/errorfs"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+type batchDurableRecorder struct {
+	mu    sync.Mutex
+	infos []BatchDurableInfo
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) record(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	r.infos = append(r.infos, info)
+}
+
+func (r *batchDurableRecorder) get() []BatchDurableInfo {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	return append([]BatchDurableInfo(nil), r.infos...)
+}
+
+func openDurabilityTestDB(t *testing.T, r *batchDurableRecorder, disableWAL bool) *DB {
+	opts := &Options{FS: vfs.NewMem(), DisableWAL: disableWAL}
+	if r != nil {
+		opts.EventListener = &EventListener{BatchDurable: r.record}
+	}
+	d, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return d
+}
+
+func TestBatchDurableEvent(t *testing.T) {
+	var r batchDurableRecorder
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, &r, false)
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+
+	// Non-sync commits do not fire.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), NoSync))
+	require.Empty(t, r.get())
+
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("c"), []byte("3"), nil))
+	size := len(b.Repr())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Commit(&WriteOptions{Sync: true, CommitCorrelationID: 42}))
+	seq := b.SeqNum()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+
+	infos := r.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	info := infos[0]
+	require.NoError(t, info.Err)
+	require.Equal(t, seq, info.SeqNum)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(42), info.CorrelationID)
+	require.Equal(t, size, info.BatchSize)
+	require.Equal(t, uint32(2), info.KeyCount)
+	require.Positive(t, info.ApplyDuration)
+	require.Positive(t, info.SyncDuration)
+	require.NotZero(t, info.JobID)
+
+	durable, err := d.DurableState()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, seq+1, durable)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(seq))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(0))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{seq, seq + 1}))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch(nil))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(info.JobID))
+	require.NoError(t, <-d.DurabilityNotify(seq))
+
+	// ApplyNoSyncWait fires from SyncWait.
+	b = d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("d"), []byte("4"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, d.ApplyNoSyncWait(b, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, b.SyncWait())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+	require.Len(t, r.get(), 2)
+
+	stats := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(2), stats.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Zero(t, stats.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Positive(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration)
+	require.Positive(t, stats.MaxSyncDuration)
+
+	m := d.Metrics()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(2), m.DurableCommitCount)
+	require.Equal(t, stats.CumulativeSyncDuration, m.DurableCommitDuration)
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityWithoutListener(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, nil, false)
+	require.Equal(t, DurabilityStats{}, d.DurabilityStats())
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), Sync))
+	stats := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), stats.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(stats.HighestDurableSeqNum))
+	// Metrics are only accumulated when BatchDurable is configured.
+	require.Zero(t, d.Metrics().DurableCommitCount)

+func TestDurabilityWaitersUnblockOnClose(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, nil, false)
+	const n = 5
+	future := base.SeqNum(1 << 40)
+	errCh := make(chan error, n)
+	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
+		go func() { errCh <- d.WaitForDurability(future) }()
+	}
+	notify := d.DurabilityNotify(future)
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
+		return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == n
+	}, 10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+
+	// Context cancellation.
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, future), context.Canceled)
+
+	// Subscriptions are bounded.
+	for i := 1; i < maxDurabilitySubscriptions; i++ {
+		_ = d.DurabilityNotify(future)
+	}
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-d.DurabilityNotify(future), ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions)
+
+	require.NoError(t, d.Close())
+	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
+		require.ErrorIs(t, <-errCh, ErrClosed)
+	}
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-notify, ErrClosed)
+	require.Zero(t, d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters)
+	// Close takes precedence over context cancellation.
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, future), ErrClosed)
+}

+func TestBatchDurableSyncFailure(t *testing.T) {
+	var failSync atomic.Bool
+	syncErr := errors.New("injected sync error")
+	fs := errorfs.Wrap(vfs.NewMem(), errorfs.InjectorFunc(func(op errorfs.Op) error {
+		if failSync.Load() && (op.Kind == errorfs.OpFileSync || op.Kind == errorfs.OpFileSyncData) && filepath.Ext(op.Path) == ".log" {
+			return syncErr
+		}
+		return nil
+	}))
+	var r batchDurableRecorder
+	d, err := Open("", &Options{
+		FS:            fs,
+		EventListener: &EventListener{BatchDurable: r.record},
+		Logger:        &mockLogger{},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	future := base.SeqNum(1 << 40)
+	notify := d.DurabilityNotify(future)
+	failSync.Store(true)
+	_ = d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), Sync)
+
+	infos := r.get()
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	require.Error(t, infos[0].Err)
+	require.Error(t, <-notify)
+	require.Error(t, d.WaitForDurability(future))
+	require.Error(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(infos[0].JobID))
+	_, err = d.DurableState()
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	stats := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), stats.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Error(t, stats.FirstErr)
+	_ = d.Close()
+}
